## Services
- [Websites & pricing](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/websites/): Compare Essential at $1,995 plus $50/month and Growth at $2,500 plus $80/month. Complete custom website scopes, ownership, support and clear configuration pricing.
- [About](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/about/): Meet Think Marketing’s approach to custom websites: explain your expertise, help customers, and build useful tools around your business. Based in Bend, Oregon.
- [FAQ](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/faq/): Answers about Think Marketing website pricing, hosting, ownership, editing, consulting and support. Explore your options with Ask Jasper or contact us.
- [Ask Jasper](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/ask-jasper/): Explore custom website packages, get guided answers, and calculate a starting estimate with Jasper. Standard tools included within agreed service limits.
- [Marketing](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/marketing/): Practical marketing consulting and Google Search PPC management for small and medium-sized businesses. Clear scope, management fees and advertising costs.
- [Local SEO](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/local-seo/): Local SEO help for Bend and Central Oregon businesses. Profile creation assistance, accurate listings, reviews displays and separately scoped improvements.
- [AI & Search Visibility](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/ai-search-visibility/): Get a $350 Search & AI Visibility Review: up to 10 pages, five questions and two AI services. Clear findings and prioritized next steps for your business.

## Pricing and scope
- Essential: $1,995 development plus $50/month; up to five pages.
- Growth: $2,500 development plus $80/month; up to ten pages; quarterly visibility summary.
- Enterprise: starting at $400/month, 12-month commitment billed from kickoff; individually scoped.
- E-commerce and Custom: individually quoted.
- Search & AI Visibility Review: $350 one-time, up to ten pages, five questions, two agreed AI services. Implementation separate.

Refer to the linked service pages for current terms. No guaranteed rankings, AI recommendations or leads. Ask Jasper offers browser-based guided answers and estimates; no connected AI chat is enabled.
